technical.summary: Volume and money flow divergence signals show accumulation, but price remains below all key moving averages with weak momentum and no trend structure—insufficient confluence for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: MMM shows weak fundamental signals with no insider/institutional activity, zero government contracts, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 1 day presents elevated volatility risk with insufficient conviction to support a directional trade.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (33/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity; congressional activity is mixed and insignificant; no recent news data to confirm sentiment.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (379.5) combined with earnings binary event in 1 day and imminent FOMC in 2 days creates compounded tail risk for MMM despite normal yield curve.

debate.key_bull_argument: Volume spike (15x), CMF cross-up, and bullish OBV divergence suggest institutional accumulation at support (122.48) in extreme fear regime (VIX 379.5), offering contrarian entry with defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Earnings binary in 1 day + FOMC in 2 days + price below all major moving averages + weak momentum (RSI, MACD, Stoch all bearish) + zero fundamental conviction creates unacceptable compounded tail risk that negates volume signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Volume accumulation and CMF cross-up suggest institutional buying at support, but this is negated by earnings binary in 1 day combined with FOMC in 2 days—unacceptable compounded tail risk.

decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on elevated risk despite technical accumulation signals
